programs.desc: Egypt's ultimate secrets may be hidden underwater; a cutting-edge archaeological investigation uses hi-tech methods to scan the ocean floor in search of sunken sphinxes, temples, and shipwrecks.

programs.title: Unearthed
programs.desc: There's a lost city buried in the Sahara, and evidence reveals it's home to Nefertiti, Tutankhamun, and the forbidden god of an outlawed religion; experts use cutting-edge tech to uncover the secret doomsday that caused this place to disappear.

programs.title: Assassination in the Valley of the Kings
programs.desc: For the first time in over 100 years, archaeologists have exclusive access inside the Valley of the Kings to excavate Pharaoh Ramses III's 3,000-year-old burial chamber, hoping to shed light on his brutal assassination as they search for burial treasures.

programs.title: Lincoln Assassination: Mysteries at the Museum
programs.desc: Don Wildman retraces John Wilkes Booth's steps in the aftermath of President Abraham Lincoln's murder, examining the motives behind the first political assassination in the United States.
